WITH latest AS (SELECT MAX(period_end) AS period_end FROM report_facts WHERE status = 'confirmed' AND metric_key IN ('stock_on_hand', 'units_sold') AND NOT period_end IS NULL), agg AS (SELECT rf.sku, p.product_name_en, SUM(CASE WHEN rf.metric_key = 'stock_on_hand' THEN rf.numeric_value END) AS stock_on_hand, SUM(CASE WHEN rf.metric_key = 'units_sold' THEN rf.numeric_value END) AS units_sold, COUNT(*) AS fact_count FROM report_facts AS rf JOIN latest AS l ON rf.period_end = l.period_end LEFT JOIN products AS p ON p.id = rf.product_id WHERE rf.status = 'confirmed' AND rf.metric_key IN ('stock_on_hand', 'units_sold') GROUP BY rf.sku, p.product_name_en) SELECT sku, product_name_en, stock_on_hand, units_sold, fact_count FROM agg ORDER BY sku LIMIT 50
